embedding.description: Absent: no embedding provider, and every document carries its own vector.

rerank.description: Optional hosted reranker. Its calls occupy a reader concurrency slot.

retrieval.description: Candidate depths, fusion weight and batched output bounds.

composition.description: Document slots: fusion first, then further unique dense and lexical hits.

name.description: Namespace ID: lowercase letters, digits and `-`, at most 63 bytes.

dense_rq_bits.description: RaBitQ bits per dimension of the dense vector index.

dense_partition_rows.description: Target rows per partition of the dense vector index.

attributes.description:
Typed attributes declared for a new namespace: name to `string`, `int`,
`float`, `bool` or `datetime`. Each is a nullable column with its own
index.

write_api.description:
Present: the writer serves `POST /v1/namespaces/{namespace}/documents`,
and a namespace created from this file or through that route takes its
documents only from the API (no `[[sources]]`). The keys are the
defaults of a new namespace; an existing one keeps its own.

NamespaceConfig.description:
The namespace this deployment serves and writes: one Lance dataset. Every
key but `name` is the default for a namespace created from this file; an
existing namespace keeps the settings it was created with.

endpoint.description: Complete HTTPS endpoint (loopback HTTP is allowed for a local provider).

candidates.description: Authorized composed documents to rerank before the request limit.

weight.description: Logistic population-z score blend; 1 uses raw reranker order, 0 fusion order.

deadline.description: One deadline for preparation and every provider call in a search batch.

spend_limit_microusd.description:
Shared process-lifetime namespace cap, in millionths of a US dollar.
Reservations are not refunded after dispatch, even on failure.

max_call_cost_microusd.description:
Operator-attested upper cost bound for any request up to 1 MiB of text.
Must cover the chosen model's billing, including repeated query tokens.
This amount is reserved before each dispatch; no provider invoice is trusted.

text_chars.description:
Optional per-candidate text bound in characters: send the window with the
most distinct query terms instead of the whole record. Absent sends the
whole record (and keeps the policy digest unchanged).

RerankConfig.description:
Optional reranking after fusion; absent configuration makes no provider calls.
Batch calls run at most four at once and occupy one reader concurrency slot
until all finish or the shared deadline expires. No retries or redirects.
Authorization is checked after connecting, immediately before emitting the
body. A revocation between that check and the provider receiving the bytes
remains possible, as with any read that returns data.

SecretRef.description: A secret taken from the environment variable `env`; never the secret itself.

Duration.description: Duration: an integer followed by ms, s, m, h or d.

rescore_depth.description: Float16 candidate refinement; legacy keeps the original fourfold depth.

source_cap.description: Soft cap per composition bucket; zero disables it.

max_documents.description: Total unique documents in a multi-query response.

RetrievalConfig.description: Retrieval policy bound into each publication's ranking identity.

oneOf.description: Expand when the exact cosine gap at the retained boundary is small.

Composition.description: Operator composition; its values are bound into the retrieval policy identity.

oneOf.description: An RFC 3339 string in requests, stored as UTC microseconds.

text_attribute.description:
The key of a row that holds its text: embedded, full-text indexed and
returned as the content of the record. It is not a typed attribute and
not one of `attributes`.

open.description:
`false`: a row is readable by the reader tokens it names, and a row
that names none by nobody. `true`: every authenticated subject of the
deployment reads every row.

WriteApiSettings.description:
How a namespace written through the HTTP API stores and shows its rows. Fixed
for the life of the namespace.

endpoint.description: Endpoint of an S3-compatible service; absent for AWS S3.

virtual_hosted_style.description: Use virtual-hosted-style requests instead of path-style.

access_key_id.description: Static credentials; absent means the default AWS credential chain.

StorageConfig.description:
The durable truth: S3 (or S3-compatible) storage, or a local directory
for single-host use. The other keys configure S3 access only.

endpoint.description:
Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible embeddings API. Empty: no provider,
and a document without a vector is refused.

prefix.description: Prefix applied to both documents and queries (same rules for both).

roles.description: Optional document/query transformations; exact UTF-8 is preserved.

send_dimensions.description: Send the configured dimension as the standard API `dimensions` field.

reader_live.description: Permit live query embeddings after reader authorization (off by default).

query_cache_max_bytes.description: Maximum query-cache bytes, including keys and vectors, per reader process.

spend.description:
Required for live calls. Scope: one reader process or writer sync
invocation, including retries; this is not an account-wide spending cap.

EmbeddingConfig.description: Embedding identity, role transformations and bounded provider access.

prefix.description: Added after the shared prefix, before the unchanged input text.

max_call_microusd.description: Upper bound on one call's cost; reserved even for an ambiguous timeout.

SpendConfig.description: Conservative reservation before every attempt, including identity probes.

encryption_key.description:
32-byte hex AEAD key, supplied only through an environment reference.
Required with a `permissions = "sync"` source, a `snapshot` or
`keycloak` directory, or writer administration.

stdio_readers.description: Tokens assigned to the configured stdio subject.

hashing_key.description: Namespace HMAC key, required; only an environment reference is accepted.

max_tokens_per_user.description: A subject with more reader tokens gets `authorization_unavailable`.

stdio_user.description: The subject of the stdio transport (one process identity).

api_keys.description:
Operator-issued bearer keys for HTTP MCP, each with its own grants
(`[[identity.api_keys]]`). Only the writer reads their secrets.

IdentityConfig.description: Identity mapping and the identity artifact.

sync_interval.description: Pull interval of the `keycloak` and `snapshot` providers.

endpoint.description: Keycloak base URL; HTTPS except explicitly allowed loopback fixtures.

client_id.description: Optional Keycloak service-account client; credentials then reference its secret.

verified_domains.description: Corporate domains accepted for Keycloak canonical e-mail keys.

snapshot_file.description: A complete generic DirectorySnapshot file, read at the writer boundary.

DirectoryConfig.description: Where canonical users and groups come from.

jwks_url.description:
Operator-pinned key endpoint; token headers never choose a URL. With
`keycloak = true` it defaults to `<issuer>/protocol/openid-connect/certs`.

keycloak.description:
Accept Keycloak's `JWT`/`Bearer` access-token profile. Defaults to
true when the issuer is taken from a Keycloak directory.

issuer.description:
Exact issuer. With a Keycloak directory it defaults to the directory's
issuer; with a Keycloak or SCIM directory it must equal it.

audience.description: Required audience: the token's `aud`, a string or an array, contains it.

OidcConfig.description: OIDC resource-server settings for HTTP MCP.

name.description:
Unique ID of the key, as source IDs are. It names the key in this file
only; the published artifacts hold its hash.

key.description:
The bearer secret, `{ env = "VAR" }`: `fyrr_key_` followed by at least
43 characters from `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`. Only the writer reads the variable.

readers.description:
Reader tokens (`usr:<id>`, `grp:<id>`) the key acts with, as
`identity.stdio_readers` states them for the stdio subject. Required
for a key with the `read` role.

roles.description:
What the key may do: `read`, `write`, `list` and `admin`. A key without
roles reads.

namespace_prefix.description: Limits the key to namespaces whose name starts with this prefix.

ApiKeyRole.description:
What an API key may do over HTTP. `list`, `write` and `admin` name roles
of routes that do not exist yet; a key holds them so that the routes need
no new key format.

sparse_read.description: Float16 refinement read backend; both paths read only admitted rows.

concurrency.description: Independent requests executing at once; the waiting queue has the same bound.

filter_count_max_rows.description: Maximum authorized rows inspected by one list_filters call; no partial counts.

nprobes.description: Nearest permission-bearing IVF partitions searched per index segment.

routing.description: IVF centroid routing; exact stays the default until scale calibration.

fts_search_chunk.description:
Full-text partitions scored by one task of a query. With 1 every
partition of an index segment is its own task, so one query scores
several partitions at once on spare compute threads. Absent keeps
Lance's default of 16, which scores up to 16 partitions one after
another. Scores do not depend on it. It takes effect only for indexes
of several partitions (`writer.fts_partition_memory_mb`).

mirror_path.description:
Local immutable-file mirror directory; default
`$XDG_CACHE_HOME/fyrr/<namespace>`, else `$HOME/.cache/fyrr/<namespace>`.

mirror_max_bytes.description: Disk limit for the read-through mirror.

memory_max_bytes.description: Reader memory envelope used for native caches and generation reservations.

memory_headroom_bytes.description: Space left unused by generation preparation for requests and allocator overhead.

version_check_interval.description: How often the reader reads the serving head for a new publication.

max_preparation.description:
Upper bound on preparing a new generation (mirror sync, maps, prewarm);
`writer.version_grace` must exceed it plus the maximum request deadline.

max_response_bytes.description:
Optional search response budget, in bytes of the serialized MCP tool result
including its structured JSON and text copies, for MCP
clients that refuse large tool results. Over budget, whole hits are dropped
from the end of the rank order (each query keeps at least 4 while another
still has tail hits); only then do the lowest-ranked hits lose their excerpt
or content. `truncated` reports both counts and the removed bytes count as
`omitted_bytes`. Absent returns every selected hit.

instructions.description:
Text sent to MCP clients as `instructions` in the `initialize` result.
Absent sends the built-in text; an empty string sends none.

operator_credential.description: Bearer credential of `POST /admin/refresh`; absent, the route is not served.

HttpConfig.description: Operator-controlled HTTP boundary and bounded authorized-state retention.

RoutingStrategy.description: Partition routing; auto is not a measured crossover.

ByteSize.description: Byte size: an integer followed by B, KiB, MiB, GiB or TiB (bytes when omitted).

credentials.description: Environment references resolved from encrypted credential records by workers.

worker_memory_max_bytes.description: Per-worker committed-memory ceiling (RLIMIT_DATA); virtual address reservations are unrestricted.

threads.description:
CPU threads of each writer process: its async runtime, Lance's compute
runtime, the parallel-iterator pool and the full-text build workers.
Absent uses every CPU of the host.

fts_partition_memory_mb.description:
Build target for one full-text index partition, in MiB of builder
memory per full-text worker (Lance's partition size, 2048 by default).
A smaller target makes a full-text index of several partitions, which a
reader can search concurrently (`reader.fts_search_chunk`); it also
keeps that size when index segments are merged. Scores do not depend on
it. The count is roughly total builder memory divided by the target.
Absent keeps Lance's default, usually one partition. Applies to the
next full-text build and merge, not to an index already published.

purge_window.description: Deleted or revoked content leaves old versions and the mirror within it.

version_grace.description: Minimum time a version is kept after it stopped serving.

max_envelope_age.description: Older pending envelopes are rejected (forcing a re-scan).

document_max_bytes.description: Default per-document size limit; larger documents are quarantined.

WriterConfig.description: Writer settings: envelopes, commit, maintenance, retention.

merge_fts_segments.description: Merge lexical deltas before publication; off preserves incremental cost.

coalescing_timer.description: `fyrr writer serve` closes a group after this long.

CommitConfig.description: Commit groups and the namespace lease.

BackpressureConfig.description: Content backpressure; permission and member work always passes.

committer.description: Run the committer role; switch off to keep batch `commit` jobs.

maintenance.description:
Run `fyrr writer maintain` when the served version has work for it
(needs the committer role); switch off to schedule it yourself.

tls_terminated.description: Required for non-loopback listeners, which must sit behind a TLS proxy.

WriterAdminConfig.description: Optional writer administration; production uses a TLS-terminating proxy.

id.description: Source ID, stable for the life of the source.

readers.description: Reader tokens (`usr:<id>`, `grp:<id>`) of a fixed connection.

scope.description: Sync scope; validated by the provider's schema.

settings.description: Provider connection settings; secrets as `{ env = "VAR" }`.

SourceIntervals.description: When each of a source's syncs is due.
